summary.runWindow: Approximately 09:02 Central; direct detection completed in 19 seconds
notes: The October 20 one-time expanded sweep is the comparison baseline. Its access observations and unresolved holds remain in effect.

The initial October 21 shell command failed before usable source requests because tab separators were stripped by the execution wrapper. It produced no URL-specific outcome and is excluded from this run.
All 25 listed URLs were then requested directly. No transport, secondary legal-marketing source, paid record, paid API, or paid external tool was used.
HTTP 403 and TLS certificate failures are operational access outcomes only. They do not establish a later document is absent or that an underlying rate or report has not changed.
